# Who I work with

## Real-time tools and the hubs

- Six of these eight are `EpiNow2` co-authors. Nikos Bosse wrote
  `scoringutils`, the forecast scoring package. Hugo Gruson and James
  Azam contribute to it
- Sebastian Funk and Kath Sherratt are co-authors on the live DRC model.
  Katelyn Gostic is at CDC

![](../figures/exchange-people-grid-a.jpg){width="82%" fig-align="center"
fig-alt="Eight collaborators on real-time tools and hubs: Sebastian Funk,
James Azam, Nikos Bosse, Kath Sherratt, Hugo Gruson, Joe Hickson, Hamada
Badr and Katelyn Gostic."}

::: {.attribution}

:::

## Delays and nowcasting

- Adrian Lison and Adam Howes are second only to me on `epinowcast`
  and `epidist`. Kaitlyn Johnson built `baselinenowcast`
- `primarycensored` is joint work. Thomas Ward, UKHSA, and Christopher
  Overton co-authored the paper. Overton was first author on the UKHSA
  mpox nowcasting

![](../figures/exchange-people-grid-b.jpg){width="82%" fig-align="center"
fig-alt="Eight collaborators on delays and nowcasting: Adrian Lison,
Kaitlyn Johnson, Adam Howes, Carl Pearson, Kelly Charniga, Sang Woo Park,
Thomas Ward and Christopher Overton, the last four shown as initials
tiles."}

::: {.attribution}
Commit counts and paper authorship, `notes/research-collaborators.md` ·
Overton et al. 2023, PLoS Comput Biol · photos from GitHub
:::

## The Julia composable work

- Top row. EpiAware, and the composable paper. Samuel Brand, Damon
  Bayer and Joseph Lemaitre built `CensoredDistributions.jl` with me.
  Hong Ge leads `Turing.jl`
- Bottom row. JuliaBayes, formed April 2026, building the tools around
  `Turing.jl`. Chains, regression models, a Bayesian workflow package

![](../figures/exchange-people-grid-c.jpg){width="86%" fig-align="center"
